prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1202; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with injuries sustained in a recent motor vehicle collision involving a vehicle insured under your policy. The collision was a low-speed head-on impact, and our client has since received medical treatment for injuries that are still being evaluated.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office. Do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. Any statements, requests for information, or settlement discussions should be addressed to the undersigned attorney at this firm.

We request that you provide a complete copy of the declarations page for the policy in question, including all liability limits, and confirm in writing the policy limits available for bodily injury and property damage coverage.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence related to this incident. This includes the insured vehicle and any event data recorder information, photographs, witness statements, claim file materials, recorded calls, and repair or appraisal records. Please take immediate steps to prevent the loss, alteration, or destruction of any such materials while this claim is pending.
